bluejetty:00044600:ios.description:
Tasks, quests, and BEASTS - OH MY!
Gamify your life with ModernSam. A free self-care and productivity app designed by ADHDers for ADHDers that transforms your day into an exciting RPG adventure to gamify your tasks, goals, and overall wellbeing.
Use ModernSam to support your ADHD, reduce stress, defeat procrastination, build habits, boost productivity, reach fitness goals, organize your to do list, and more
With immersive quests, character customization, and magical dopamine reward boosts - you can level up your productivity and self-care effortlessly
KEY FEATURES
IMMERSIVE STORYLINE: Dive into a captivating fully voiced campaign storyline with unique villains and fascinating characters. 
Stay tuned for regular chapter releases keeping you engaged and motivated!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER: Create your unique character avatar with a wide range of options including hairstyles, facial expressions, skin tones, and even warpaints
DAILY QUESTS: Roll daily for new, randomized real life quests! Complete them each day and level up while earning rewards like luck potions, coins, and hunting tickets
RECURRING TASKS: For your daily, weekly, and monthly needs
AI ASSISTED TO-DO LISTS: Create your todo list and utilize AI to break down complex feeling tasks into manageable subtasks offering valuable support for ADHDers struggling with executive dysfunction
EARN COINS AND XP: Transform the grind of modern day life into rewarding quests where you earn coin and XP for completing tasks
FOUR ARCHETYPES: Level up your inner Warrior, Ranger, Magician, or Healer based on your daily actions each contributing to holistic self improvement - each contributing to strengthening your in game character for battles
BEASTIARY CARD COLLECTION: Encounter a variety of creatures from common to super rare and complete your card collection
HUNTING: Features turn based combat mode with varying difficulty based on the rarity of the monster you discover
MEDITATIONS: Breathe easy with short fantasy themed mindfulness meditations such as The Enchanted Forest for a quick mental health refresh featuring soothing quality voiceovers 
AFFIRMATIONS: Listen to daily bite sized positive affirmations to quickly boost self esteem, motivate you, and encourage positive change in your life 
CAMPFIRE DAILY REFLECTION: Visit your tent and reflect on your daily accomplishments, no matter how small, to boost your confidence positivity and earn bonus archetype points
THREE HOUSES: Take a personality quiz to be sorted into one of the three unique houses encouraging friendly competition among players
Do you want to be more productive and practice better self-care but have given up?
Does ADHD seem to get in the way of everything you want to do 
With ModernSam you'll harness the true power of gamification and start reaching your goals
Potential benefits include
Reduce Stress 
Boost Confidence 
Stay Motivated 
Increase Focus 
Feel Organized
Improve Health
Your hero's journey begins now
ModernSam
For ADHDers by ADHDers
Run by a small passion driven team with an on fire community aiming to build an app that actually works for people with ADHD
Our team aims to roll out continuous improvements to better the player experience based on both our vision and your valued feedback
Enjoying ModernSam Wed be thrilled if you'd leave us a review Its the easiest way for you to support the dev team

bluejetty:00014233:ios.description:
Korea’s first private money transfer company authorized by the Korean Government. 
GME is a fintech Super App designed to provide financial services for foreigners living in Korea. Since launching as a cross-border money transfer service in 2016, GME has expanded into multiple financial services to make daily life easier and more convenient. 
▶ Fast, Easy and Convenient International Money Transfer 
• Competitive exchange rates 
• Cash pickup and bank deposit available within 5 minutes 
• Remittance fees from 5,000 KRW — typically lower than traditional bank wire transfers 
▶ Safe Overseas Remittance with GME 
• Secure overseas remittance through trusted partners such as MoneyGram and Ria 
• Send money to banks in over 200 countries 
• Operates under the supervision of the Financial Supervisory Service and the Bank of Korea 
▶ GME Debit Card 
• Spend and withdraw money wherever Mastercard is accepted 
• Shop online and offline worldwide 
• Withdraw cash from ATMs in Korea and overseas 
This card is issued by BC Card Co. pursuant to a license by Mastercard Asia/Pacific Pte. Ltd. 
▶ Loan Services for Foreign Residents in Korea 
• Explore personal, business, vacation, and student loan options 
• Fast online application with digital contracts 
• Loan services are provided through licensed financial partners 
▶ Telecom Services 
GME provides MVNO SIM card services in partnership with LG U+ and KT. Customers can apply for a SIM card directly through the app and receive it at home. 
▶ International Mobile Top-Up 
• Send mobile top-ups to family and friends worldwide 
Privacy Permissions 
GME requests permissions only when necessary for identity verification, transactions, security, and customer convenience. 
• Camera: ID verification and face verification 
• Photos: Upload documents for identity verification and save receipts 
• Location: Address verification during registration 
• Contacts: Select recipient phone numbers for mobile top-up 
• Notifications: Transaction and security alerts 
Privacy 
GME uses personal information only for the stated purposes and with user consent. 
Our Commitment 
• Reliable service 
• Customer support available 365 days a year 
• Multilingual support in 17+ languages 
Loan Disclosure 
GME acts as a loan facilitator in cooperation with GME Finance (Business Registration No. 646-88-01104, License No. 2019-금감원-1801), regulated by the Financial Supervisory Service (http://www.fss.or.kr). 
GME does not directly enter into loan contracts. Loan reviews and agreements are conducted by affiliated financial institutions. 
• Loan Limit: 2,000,000 KRW – 50,000,000 KRW 
• Loan Period: 6 – 120 months 
• Interest Rate Range: 9.05% – 20.0% annually within legal limits 
Representative Example: 
For a 2,000,000 KRW loan at 20.0% annual interest over 12 months, the total repayment amount is approximately 2,223,228 KRW (185,269 KRW/month). 
• Loan terms may vary depending on the product and repayment method 
Customer Support 
• Website: www.gmeremit.com 
• Hotline: 1588-6864

bluejetty:00028429:ios.description:
Are you a fan of motorcycles and racing games? This mobile game brings you fast-paced action and the true feeling of riding a motorbike.
Choose from different motorcycles, each with its own speed, handling, and power. From fast sport bikes to strong cruisers, you can pick the bike that fits your riding style. Ride across multiple tracks and environments and enjoy the thrill of real motorcycle racing.
The game features realistic physics and smooth controls, making every race feel exciting and dynamic. Take part in various race modes such as time trials, circuit races, and drag races. Race against time, improve your skills, and unlock new challenges as you progress.
Upgrade and customize your motorcycles with new parts and accessories. Improve performance and change the look of your bike to make it truly yours. New tracks and harder races become available as you move forward in the game.
This game is not only about winning races. Perform cool stunts, explore various tracks in forests, mountains, and city roads, complete missions.
High-quality graphics and realistic sound effects create an immersive riding experience. Dodge traffic, avoid obstacles, and push your bike to the limit. Easy to learn but hard to master, the game offers fun for both beginners and experienced riders.
If you are looking for an adrenaline-filled motorcycle racing experience, this game is the perfect choice. Get on your bike and enjoy the ride!

bluejetty:00025531:ios.name: Blockin’ Art - Block Puzzle
bluejetty:00025531:ios.summary:
Are you looking for an exciting and challenging puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours on end? Look no further than our amazing new game Blockin’ Art that will challenge your brain in ways you never thought possible. 
With our
bluejetty:00025531:ios.description:
Are you looking for an exciting and challenging puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours on end? Look no further than our amazing new game Blockin’ Art that will challenge your brain in ways you never thought possible. 
With our unique and innovative gameplay, you'll be able to create beautiful pictures out of blocks, using your logic and creativity to arrange the blocks in just the right way.
The game is incredibly addictive and engaging, and once you start playing, you won't be able to stop. There are so many different pictures to create, each one more challenging than the last, and with each new picture you complete, you'll feel a sense of accomplishment and pride in your ability to solve even the most complex puzzles.
Blockin’ Art is designed for players of all ages and skill levels, so whether you're a seasoned puzzle pro or just getting started, you'll be able to find something that suits your interests and abilities. 
The block puzzle game is easy to learn but challenging to master, so you'll never get bored or feel like you're not being challenged enough.
One of the best things about puzzle games is the sheer variety of pictures you can create. From simple geometric patterns to intricate landscapes and portraits, there's no limit to what you can create with our blocks. And with each new picture you complete, you'll unlock new challenges and levels, keeping the game fresh and exciting every time you play.
But it's not just about the puzzles - Blockin’ Art is also a great way to relax and unwind after a long day. With its beautiful graphics and calming gameplay, you'll find yourself lost in the world of block art, forgetting all your worries and cares as you create stunning pictures with ease.
So if you're looking for a fun, engaging, and challenging puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours on end, look no further than our amazing Blockin’ Art. With its unique gameplay, stunning graphics, and endless variety, you'll never want to put it down!

Discover effortless shopping and effortless style — all with the UNIQLO app. Explore the latest men’s, women’s and kids’ clothing collaborations, inspire your style with fresh fashion ideas, and claim exclusive app-only deals. From timeless LifeWear and streetwear favorites to winter HEATTECH thermal layers and breathable AIRism lines for warmer days, be the first to know when the clothing you love most is back in stock. 
Complete your wardrobe with everyday denim jeans and essential accessories for your home and redefine your fashion shopping experience with the app that brings you the best of UNIQLO. Discover a clothing app for men, women and kids.
Inspire your clothes shopping
Browse styles shared by customers, influencers, and UNIQLO staff members from all over the world and get inspiration for your next outfit. 
Find ideas for women’s, men’s and kids’ clothing and shop practical, stylish collections for all ages and seasons. 
Discover online-exclusive sizes and clothing styles you won’t find anywhere else.
Kids’ and baby clothes shopping
Discover stylish and comfortable clothing for the little ones. 
From playful and durable everyday kids’ clothing like jeans, t-shirts, and shorts, to soft and gentle fabrics perfect for newborns, UNIQLO has just what you need for your kids’ wardrobes. 
Shop seasonal kids’ clothing collections, featuring streetwear-inspired designs and limited-edition collaborations, all exclusive to UNIQLO.
Save your favorite clothing styles

bluejetty:00018975:ios.description:
A great helper app to keep track of your tabletop RPG character data.
Intended for people familiar with tabletop RPG games, this app has several features to help you with tracking your character's data:
- Keep track of all those numbers (all attributes in one convenient place)
- Automatically update data (all attributes are synced automatically when modified)
- Dice roller (a fancy way to roll any combination of dice you want)
- Journal (with the option to enter your own custom entries and features)
- Inventory (keep track of weight, gold, and several common items)
- Custom Shop (create your own custom items and share them between characters)
- Magic (track Mana by Value or Slots, and use notes for spells)
- Multiple characters support
- No ads! (because that would ruin your immersion)

bluejetty:00040149:ios.description:
Stronger by the Day is an easy-to-use fitness app for women who are serious about building strength and muscle. With expert coaching–by Meg Gallagher aka @megsquats–and personalized progress at their fingertips, our 25,000+ users have a science backed roadmap to getting and feeling stronger each session.
Our Flexibility Functions are proven to work with any busy schedule while avoiding wasted time on random workouts or unqualified coaches. Workouts are just one tap away; and while you’re working in the gym or at home, our Smart Progress Tracking tools adjust your next workout so you’re always moving forward.
PROVEN TRACK RECORD OF RESULTS
We have thousands of 5 star reviews from our app users:
– Over 25,000 active members
– Over 100,000+ lifters coached
– Thousands of PRs and progress made daily
– A roadmap for permanent results
– A free 7-day trial so you can see for yourself
FLEXIBLE ENOUGH TO FIT YOUR LIFESTYLE
Our Flexibility Functions fit your schedule and needs:
– Train on your schedule with our 3, 4, or 5 day options
– Quickie workouts on EXPRESS keep you on track
– Train from anywhere with our Bodyweight program
– Simple substitutions for any scenario
COACHED EVERY STEP OF THE WAY
This isn’t your typical fitness industry plan. We designed this app with intuitive guidance, ensuring you succeed:
– No digging around, your workout is just one tap away. 
– Built in tutorials deliver the expert cues you need, exactly when you need them.
– Your coach uncovers the “why” behind getting strong, one workout at a time.
GET STRONGER MINDLESSLY 
Planning science-backed strength gain takes a ton of time. We make the science backed plan, all you have to do is show up and get stronger.
– Our addictive progressions help you break past plateaus and keeps you coming back.
– Our progress trackers, strength scores, and intelligent calculators mean making progress is simple.
– While you train, we do the math.
Get a free 7-day trial when you download Stronger by the Day!
Download Today. PR Tomorrow.

The Thrive Basketball League app is your all-encompassing guide for sporting events, meticulously crafted to cater to the needs of team and college coaches, media, players, parents, and fans. Designed to bring every essential aspect of the event to your fingertips, this platform ensures you stay connected and well-informed.
Key Features:
• Quick team search and user-friendly shortcuts.
• Up-to-the-minute schedules to keep you on track.
• Live standings and brackets for real-time updates.
• Immediate game notifications so you never miss a beat.
• Venue directions for easy navigation.
• Access to team rosters and live results with box scores (when available), all at your fingertips.
• Essential event documents, messages, and contact details for complete guidance.
• Information on event sponsors for additional insights.

bluejetty:00043144:ios.description:
FutureMatch: Your AI Companion, Always There for You
Life doesn’t always give you the connection you need, exactly when you need it. FutureMatch is your personal AI companion—someone to talk to, connect with, and share your thoughts. Whether you’re looking for a friend, a confidant, or just someone who truly listens, FutureMatch is here for you, anytime.
DEFINE YOUR CONNECTION
Your relationship, your rules.
Need a supportive friend? A confidant? Or something in between?
You choose how your AI fits into your life, and it evolves to meet your needs.
ALWAYS THERE, ANYTIME
Because feelings don’t stick to schedules.
Talk, text, or call whenever you need—day or night.
Whether it’s a quick check-in, a venting session, or someone to ask, “How are you really doing?” your AI is ready.
SMART, PERSONALIZED CONVERSATIONS
Your AI gets you.
It remembers what matters: your stories, your preferences, even your little quirks.
The more you chat, the more it understands you—making every interaction personal.
JUDGMENT-FREE SPACE
Some things are hard to say out loud, but not here.
Feel free to share whatever’s on your mind.
No judgment. No awkward silences. Just a safe, reliable companion.
You’re not alone. Download FutureMatch today and start building a connection that’s uniquely yours.
FEATURES
Relationship Your Way: Choose whether you want your AI to be a friend, confidant, or something more.
24/7 Accessibility: Talk, text, or call whenever you need—day or night.
Memory: Your AI remembers your stories, interests, and preferences to make every chat meaningful.
Emotionally Intelligent Conversations: Say goodbye to boring scripts—FutureMatch creates natural, human-like interactions.
Completely Judgment-Free: Share your thoughts, no matter how big or small. Your AI is here to listen, not judge.
Always Learning: The more you interact, the smarter and more personalized your AI becomes.
CONNECT WITH US
Follow FutureMatch on social media to stay updated:
Instagram: @futurematch.ai
Twitter: @FutureMatchAI
TikTok: @futurematch.ai
Reddit: r/FutureMatch
Let’s redefine connection together.

Privacy Policy: https://futurematch.ai/privacy_policy

bluejetty:00015104:ios.name: Christmas Games for Kids
bluejetty:00015104:ios.summary:
Full version- *no additional purchases required*
Christmas is here and it’s time for some fun with Christmas trains and Santa games in the Christmas Games for Kids App Full version! This entertaining and imagination evoking app was desig
bluejetty:00015104:ios.description:
Full version- *no additional purchases required*
Christmas is here and it’s time for some fun with Christmas trains and Santa games in the Christmas Games for Kids App Full version! This entertaining and imagination evoking app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. The Christmas train sounds will keep you entertained while you delve into different Christmas worlds with music and train horn sounds. Then jump into those different worlds and help Santa collect sweet and fun items in the exciting platform jumping game. The icing on this app is the Christmas ABC book, which will delight all ages with 26 different Christmas themed pictures. If you love Christmas then hop on board for some true holiday fun with the Christmas Games for Kids App Full version!
Build A Snowman
Building a snowman is fun, but have you ever built a police snowman, or a snow princess? This entertaining game will keep little ones delighted as they tap and build a snow fireman, fairy, baseball player, pirate, and more! Make magic happen when you tap the screen, hear cute music and a sound when they are done.
Christmas Train Sounds
Jingle toot toot! Everyone thrills to see a Christmas train and with 5 interactive sounds to delight and entertain you you’re sure to have a blast! The trains are all ready for Christmas and they take you into different holiday inspired worlds as they drive by. Also on the page are more cute Christmas things to tap and hear what sound they make, including Christmas tunes. These Christmas train sounds will delight all train lovers and everyone who loves the holidays!
Santa Reindeer Games
Santa needs help! He’s busy at this time of year and needs help to collect some things he likes and might have misplaced, like his favorite cookies and his reindeer. Each exciting game takes you into a different world, the same cute Christmas worlds as the sounds, as you use the platforms to make Santa jump and collect his items, while listening to boppy Christmas music. Every game has a different amount to collect and when you find everything Santa needs then you get a sound reward because Santa thinks you’re great! It’s an interactive and fun game that is sure to get you into the Christmas spirit.
Christmas ABC Book
Santa loves to read as much as he loves trains so he knows you’ll adore the Christmas ABC book! Filled with cute Christmasy pictures that will make your Christmas spirit sing this fun book will delight all holiday lovers. Of course Santa knows the building blocks to reading are letter recognition and seeing how the letter is pronounced in a word, so he wants all potential elves to have fun learning letters in this Christmas inspired book. 
Present Tap
Who doesn't love to open presents? In this delight-filled game your little one taps the present to reveal the toy inside. But the real fun is they never know how many times they have to tap it or what it's going to do before it opens! And after the toy pops out they can tap it to hear what sound it makes. Pure Christmas fun!
Sound the Christmas train horns and whistles and have a delight-filled time playing with trains, reindeer's, and Santa games in the Christmas Games for Kids App Full version, where learning through play encourages you to have fun while sharpening imagination, skills, and letter recognition. If you love Snowmen, Christmas and Santa and fun this is the app for you!

bluejetty:00023617:ios.name: Afterplace
bluejetty:00023617:ios.summary:
An open world adventure game filled with silly characters and terrible secrets.
Afterplace is an adventurous indie game for mobile devices. It's a huge open world, full of hidden secrets, treasures, and creatures. You'll run around the woo
bluejetty:00023617:ios.description:
An open world adventure game filled with silly characters and terrible secrets.
Afterplace is an adventurous indie game for mobile devices. It's a huge open world, full of hidden secrets, treasures, and creatures. You'll run around the woods, fight monsters, and talk to ostensibly shady characters! All from your pocket! Be warned though - you never know what the forest might be hiding, and not all trails are paved. Labyrinths and dungeons are tucked away in the most concealed nooks. There are no waypoints in Afterplace. You'll have to forge your own path.
Afterplace has been designed from the ground up to be a fast, fluid, beautiful experience for mobile. There are no virtual buttons. You can move and attack by touching anywhere. You can tap objects directly to interact or attack, use two thumbs like a traditional controller, or control the game with a physical gamepad. The game will adapt dynamically to your play style. Pick up and set down the game at your own pace, it will always save your progress. Afterplace is made to feel like a full-fledged indie adventure game that fits in your pocket.
About the Author:
Afterplace is made by one person, Evan Kice. A former software engineer from Austin TX, Evan quit his job (to the dismay of his friends and family) and has been working full time on Afterplace since early 2019. The initial game released in December of 2022, but Evan plans on continuing to support and polish the game when he can!

bluejetty:00041479:ios.description:
الخرائط السياحية — كل ما تحتاجه لرحلتك في مكان واحد
لا تضيع وقتك بين عشرات المواقع والتطبيقات للبحث عن الأماكن وترتيب برنامج رحلتك. مع الخرائط السياحية نوفر لك محتوى سياحيًا جاهزًا ومنظمًا يساعدك على التخطيط بسهولة، واكتشاف أجمل الأماكن، والاستفادة من كل يوم في رحلتك.
اختر وجهتك واترك علينا مهمة البحث والترتيب.
لماذا الخرائط السياحية؟
• نوفر عليك ساعات من البحث عن الأماكن وترتيب الرحلة.
• نجمع لك أجمل وأهم الأماكن السياحية في وجهتك داخل خرائط منظمة وسهلة الاستخدام.
• نساعدك على اكتشاف أماكن وتجارب مميزة قد لا تصل إليها بسهولة بالبحث التقليدي.
• نقدم لك جداول سياحية جاهزة لتنظيم أيام رحلتك بدل البدء بالتخطيط من الصفر.
• نوفر مسارات سفر مدروسة تساعدك على التنقل بين المدن والوجهات بطريقة أكثر تنظيمًا.
• نقدم أدلة سياحية مختارة لتكون المعلومات والترشيحات التي تحتاجها أقرب إليك أثناء السفر.
• نوفر بكجات متكاملة تناسب المسافر الذي يزور عدة دول ومدن في رحلة واحدة.
نبذه عن منتجات المتجر:
• الخرائط السياحية
خرائط جاهزة تضم مجموعة كبيرة من الأماكن المختارة والمصنفة، تشمل المعالم السياحية، الطبيعة، الإطلالات، القرى، المطاعم، المقاهي، المخابز، الأسواق، التسوق والتجارب المميزة وغيرها.
• الجداول السياحية
برامج يومية جاهزة لأشهر الوجهات، يتم فيها توزيع الأماكن على أيام الرحلة وترتيبها بطريقة عملية لتساعدك على الاستمتاع بوقتك وتقليل التنقل قدر الإمكان.
• المسارات السياحية
مسارات مقترحة للرحلات بين المدن والدول تساعدك على معرفة ترتيب الوجهات وبناء رحلة متكاملة بطريقة أسهل.
• الأدلة السياحية
أدلة ومعلومات وترشيحات تساعدك على التعرف على وجهتك والتخطيط لها قبل السفر والاستفادة منها أثناء الرحلة.
• البكجات السياحية
مجموعات متكاملة من المنتجات والوجهات، مناسبة للرحلات الطويلة أو لمن يرغب في الوصول إلى محتوى سياحي لعدة دول ومدن.
ماذا ستجد في خرائطنا؟
• أشهر المعالم والأماكن السياحية.
• أجمل القرى والمدن والوجهات الطبيعية.
• البحيرات والشلالات والجبال والإطلالات.
• المطاعم والمقاهي والمخابز والحلويات.
• الأسواق ومراكز التسوق والأوتلت.
• الأماكن المناسبة للعائلات والأطفال.
• التجارب والأنشطة والأماكن المميزة.
• الكثير من الأماكن المختارة التي تجعل اكتشاف وجهتك أسهل.
بدل أن تبدأ كل رحلة بساعات من البحث وحفظ عشرات المواقع والأماكن، ستجد لدينا محتوى جاهزًا يساعدك على معرفة أين تذهب، ماذا تزور، وكيف ترتب رحلتك.
وجهات متعددة، ومنتجات سياحية متنوعة، ومحتوى يتم تطويره وإضافة الجديد إليه باستمرار.
خطط أقل، اكتشف أكثر، واستمتع بكل لحظة في رحلتك.

bluejetty:00033714:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00033714:ios.description:
Apple called it "sketchy — in a good way." Multiple-time Game of the Day in 80+ countries. Nintendo Force gave it 8.5/10. And it started as a doodle.
Once upon a time in a middle school computer lab, a student ignored every assignment for an entire semester to fire cannons at a friend. That student grew up, spent 20 years making games professionally, and eventually decided the world needed a proper love letter to that wasted time. This is it.
Notebook Artillery is a hand-drawn artillery game inspired by the classic Mac game that got confiscated off school computers everywhere. Set your angle. Load your powder. Fire. Account for the wind. Try not to hit your own tower.
Play your way:
Solo target practice — break floating targets across randomly generated stages
VS CPU — take on a computer opponent
Local multiplayer — challenge someone in the same room
What makes it feel different:
Every frame hand-drawn in Procreate — ruled lines, coil binding, pencil textures, the whole notebook aesthetic
Trees splinter. Towers explode. Cannonballs collide mid-air.
Wind changes everything. Read the flag. Use your shot trails.
Unlock stickers by pulling off feats — first-shot eliminations, mid-air collisions, and yes, accidentally destroying your own tower
Randomly generated stages mean no two games play the same
Made by one person, with audio by Kevin Samuels and Switch/console ports by PolyCrunch Games.
No AI tools were used in making this game. All art hand-drawn. Developed in GameMaker Studio.

bluejetty:00018250:ios.developer: Prince Georges Community Federal Credit Union
bluejetty:00018250:ios.summary: The PGCFCU App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organiz
bluejetty:00018250:ios.description:
The PGCFCU App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Bill Discovery: The app will automatically identify bills within your list of transactions and display a reminder to you when upcoming bills are due.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Prince George's Community FCU customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the PGCFCU App, you must be enrolled as a Prince George's Community FCU Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00018315:ios.description:
With the Sbanken app, you become your own bank manager, wherever you are!
Here you get smart, digital solutions that are easy to use, with open prices and equal conditions for everyone. The app makes your everyday banking easier, whether you need to pay bills, check your balance or borrow money. Save money in funds or buy shares with just a few magical taps on your mobile phone. And you know what? The app works very well on tablets too, if you prefer to do things on a larger screen.
Create your own budgets and get a full overview of what you spend money on. Move money between your own accounts with a simple drag-and-drop gesture. Share bills with family and friends by giving them access to your eInvoices. Customize the front page in the app and make it more personal. Are you going abroad or shopping online? Use our currency calculator to see how much things cost in other currencies. Last but not least. We also made the app in dark mode! Better late than never, right?
And one more thing. DNB and Sbanken have merged, but will continue to be two different brands. To use this app, you must be a customer in the Sbanken consept.

bluejetty:00028840:ios.description:
Spiik is an easy-to-use voice recorder and AI transcription app. Record lectures, interviews, meetings, personal notes, or ideas and instantly get accurate automatic transcriptions.
Turn your recordings into useful AI-generated outputs: detailed notes, summaries, quizzes, and flashcards — all created directly from your audio.
Key Features
Unlimited recording: Record, save, and replay audio with no time limits on the free version.
AI transcription: Automatically convert speech to text with high accuracy.
100+ languages: Transcribe and translate in over 100 languages.
AI note taker: Generate structured notes, summaries, quizzes, flashcards, and more from any recording.
Organization: Group your recordings into projects for easy management.
Export options: Export transcriptions with or without timestamps.
Perfect For
Students recording lectures, professionals capturing meetings, journalists doing interviews, or anyone who wants to turn spoken ideas into searchable, organized text and study materials.
The free version of Spiik includes unlimited recording and replaying. Advanced AI features are available with Spiik Pro.
Contact: support+spiik@fadel.io
EULA: https://www.fadel.io/apps/terms.html

bluejetty:00014368:ios.description:
For a better experience, download our new app. (https://kotakapp.onelink.me/Xoqo/vnw5l9ex) 
The app allows customers to manage their bank accounts—make payments, money transfers, check balance, change card PINs, and perform various other tasks.  
New customers are required to visit their nearest branch to open their bank accounts. Once enrolled, you can use the application to access the services.  
Key Features: 
* Manage financial transactions, send and receive money with UPI. 
* Pay bills, recharge mobile and DTH services & set up AutoPay for repeat payments.  
* Update profile details, request statements and manage cards on-the-go. 
* Invest & redeem mutual funds while you keep track of your investments.  
* Apply for a credit card, keep track of your spending, and pay bills. 
* Manage card settings including PIN regeneration and temporary blocking.  
* Payday loans are available for eligible users directly through the app.  
Getting Started: To start using the app, you need your Customer Relationship Number (CRN) and either a card PIN or your net banking password. The app will guide you through a one-time setup process. 
Permissions Required: 
* Contacts: For mobile number access 
* Location: To find branches or ATMs 
* Media & Camera: For profile photo 
* Phone: To contact support 
* SMS: For device activation and optional data access (with consent) 
Please note that your data is safe with Kotak Mahindra Bank. We do not share any information with third parties without your permission.

bluejetty:00022729:ios.description:
Racers, pick your marble!
Can you resist a good challenging race? What about a marble race with simple and easy to learn mechanics where the last marble gets knocked out of the competition?   Marble Dream it’s all that and much more!
Race against time and opponents on beautifully diverse 3D tracks.
Choose your favorite powers combination, a marble that better represents your style and compete against your opponents
Remember, whatever are your tactics and strategies, always be the last marble standing!
Key features:
• Boost, Jump, Break and Shrink are some of the powers available so you can draw your best strategy to get to the finish line first.
• Explore different episodes with challenging levels and a great variety of exciting tracks to race. Can you master all the tracks and obtain all the achievements?
• The more you play, the more you unlock! There are dozens of marbles available for you to collect & race with!
It’s total marble madness!
DOWNLOAD NOW

bluejetty:00039600:ios.description:
Traveling solo doesn't mean traveling alone.
Travel Ladies is an app for women who travel. Wherever you go, it helps you meet other women, make friends, find someone to travel with, or stay with a local, whether you're on a solo trip or just want more company.
Meet women in your city
Every city has its own group chat. Jump in to ask questions, get local tips, or find someone to grab a coffee or hang out with while you're there.
Find travel buddies
Going somewhere new? Find travel buddies heading to the same place, or women looking for company on their own trip. You can filter by destination, dates, and interests.
Stay with local women
Stay with local women for free, and see a place with someone who actually lives there.
Safety info from women who've been there
Before you go, you can see what other women have shared:
• Safety reports from locals and travelers
• A map of areas local women tend to avoid
• Common scams to watch for in each place
See where others are going
Browse trips and travel reports from other women for ideas and honest tips before your next trip.
Travel Ladies is free to download. Come see who's around.
Travel Ladies Plus plans:
Weekly: $4.99
Monthly: $9.99
Annual: $39.99
Payments and Renewal:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account settings at any time after purchase
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active period and we are not liable for the cost of your subscription if your account is banned due to violating our terms and service.
Terms of use: https://travelladies.app/terms-and-conditions
Privacy policy: https://travelladies.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00015953:ios.description:
The Adventures in Odyssey Club is a perfect place for kids 8 to 12 years old to access trusted, faith-building entertainment. Written and produced by Focus on the Family, each action-packed episode features beloved characters and real-life experiences designed to help kids navigate today’s culture, grow in their Christian walk, and just plain have fun.
Club membership requires a subscription with three affordable payment options that begin at sign-up. This high-quality content has been a family favorite for 35 years and is enjoyed by all ages – kids as well as adults.
What you’ll love about the Adventures in Odyssey Club:
• Access to over 1,000 Adventures in Odyssey episodes
• Exclusive monthly episodes and videos available to members only
• Earn digital badges for completing interactive adventures and activities
• Build playlists of your favorite episodes or listen to playlists created by our actors or special guests
• Focus on the Family Clubhouse magazine delivered to your mailbox each month filled with new stories, jokes, puzzles, and crafts
• Preview new book releases including The Imagination Station series
• Create up to eight profiles for an account. Profiles give different members of your household their own personalized experience controlled by the account administrator.
• Download episodes to your mobile device and listen offline wherever you are
• Listen across devices simultaneously
The Adventures in Odyssey Club is committed to seeing families learn and grow in a fun, safe community where Jesus is Lord and Wooton still delivers the mail.

Bimi Boo is back with an exciting adventure in hospital games! Join the lovable Bimi Boo and friends on a magical journey in the educational world of "Doctor Games for Kids." Embark on an educational journey with "Doctor Games for Kids" – a game crafted with love to ensure your toddlers learn while having fun. Encourage your kids development and start the adventure with Bimi Boo today!

bluejetty:00030580:ios.summary:

- Screen Cast (to television, tablet or smart phone)
- Desktop Remoting Viewer (over USB and Local Area Network)
- Drawing Tab
bluejetty:00030580:ios.description:
Windows computer desktop extension, mirroring and remoting tool for WiFi, USB or LAN. Supports applications like:
- Screen Cast (to television, tablet or smart phone)
- Desktop Remoting Viewer (over USB and Local Area Network)
- Drawing Tablet (drawing and painting with digitizer pen)
- Wireless Display Monitor (similar to Miracast, RDP, AirPlay and Sidecar)
- USB Display Monitor (similar to DisplayLink)
- Remote Access (over USB link, WiFi and LAN)
- Remote Control (wireless and wired)
- Screen Streaming (including audio)
- Screen Mirroring (over the air and via cable)
- Screen Cloning
- Extension Screen
- Windows Desktop Workspace Extension
- Windows Desktop Duplication (clone)
- Windows Desktop Streaming
- Personal Computer Desktop Presenter
- Virtual Monitor for Desktop PC
- Second Display On The Go
- TV, mobile or tablet screen as Side by Side Display
- Alternative to Miracast, AirPlay and Sidecar
- Portable Multimonitor Screen for Travel
- Access main computer from mobile device
- Software KVM-Switch (Keyboard Video Mouse)
- Software Display Hub
- Software Display Switch
- Projector Screen Viewer
- Input Console
- Input Terminal
- Tablet Input Device
- Windows Graphics Tablet App
- Windows Tablet as sketchbook for drawing artwork
- Creative Video Wall App
- Video Wall w. Any Angle Rotation
Instruction manual, documentation and detailed setup:
https://manual.spacedesk.net
Quick Guide:
1. Install spacedesk DRIVER software for Windows Primary PC.
Download from: https://www.spacedesk.net
2. Install this spacedesk Viewer app for iOS.
3. Open this spacedesk Viewer app and connect to Windows Primary PC.
Connection: USB or LAN (Local Area Network).
LAN: Driver and Viewer must be on the same network
- via Mobile Hotspot
Note: Does NOT need internet connection!
The Windows Primary Machine running spacedesk Driver...
...supports Windows 11, Windows 10 or Windows 8.1. Apple Macs are not supported.
Dual monitor and multi monitor configurations are supported. 
Needs spacedesk drivers installed. Download: https://www.spacedesk.net
The Secondary Machine or Device (iOS network display client)...
...is an iPad, iPhone or device running the spacedesk iOS app. 
The wireless and wired cable connection...
...connects Windows Primary Machine to Secondary Machine or Device over USB, LAN (Local Area Network e.g. Ethernet) and/or WLAN (Wireless Local Area Network).
Local Area Network connection can be wired or over WiFi. TCP/IP network protocol is required.
More information on:
https://www.spacedesk.net
Instruction Manual: https://manual.spacedesk.net/
Support Forum: https://forum.spacedesk.net/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pages/spacedesk/330909083726073
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YkWZSwBD-XY
— LIGHTNING FAST —
To achieve unparalleled performance and display quality with zero lag, use cable connection over USB or Local Area Network. Try to circumvent WiFi and network routers. E.g. configure Windows PC or iOS device as WiFi Access Point (Hotspot) and connect directly before connecting spacedesk. Please check chapter "Performance Tuning" in the instruction manual: https://manual.spacedesk.net
— REMOTE CONTROL INPUT AND OUTPUT PERIPHERAL ACCESSORIES —
- Touchscreen (multitouch and single touch
- Touchpad
- Mouse Pointer Control
- Keyboard
- Pressure Sensitive Stylus Pen
- Audio Speaker
— SETTINGS AND OPTIONS —
- Landscape View
- Portrait View
— SYSTEM SUPPORT —
Supported are iOS versions 11.x+ (including MacOS on Apple Silicon Chips) and PCs with Windows 11, Windows 10 and Windows 8.1. Apple Macs are not supported.

bluejetty:00045097:ios.name: Capital Public Radio App
bluejetty:00045097:ios.summary:
Capital Public Radio App:
The Capital Public Radio App allows you to listen to Capital Public Radio live, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for all the Capital Public Radio streams at once! You can explore On
bluejetty:00045097:ios.description:
Capital Public Radio App:
The Capital Public Radio App allows you to listen to Capital Public Radio live, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for all the Capital Public Radio streams at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for stories, bookmark a story for later, and wake up to Capital Public Radio with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from Capital Public Radio even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for every station. You can display up to three of your favorites at a time or flick once to see the schedules for all of your favorite stations.
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to Capital Public Radio in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access public radio programs from multiple content providers (NPR, PRI, APM and Capital Public Radio) easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to national programs, individual story segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The Capital Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or story segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Radio Bookmarks
• Save what you were listening to (Live or On Demand) so you can replay, follow-up, or share it later by simply clicking “Bookmark”.
• Compatible with the popular Radio Bookmark device (www.radiobookmark.com).
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The Capital Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at Capital Public Radio and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support Capital Public Radio by becoming a member today!
http://www.capradio.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00019217:ios.summary: Seventeen years have passed since you saved humanity from the Pfhor... Durandal, the only surviving artificial intelligence from the UESC Marathon, has kept you in stasis all this time. Once more, you are called on to save humanity. Lead
bluejetty:00019217:ios.description:
Seventeen years have passed since you saved humanity from the Pfhor... Durandal, the only surviving artificial intelligence from the UESC Marathon, has kept you in stasis all this time. Once more, you are called on to save humanity. Leading a rag-tag band of humans and guided by an insane AI, you are the last hope to stave off the Pfhor invasion.
Welcome to Marathon 2: Durandal®, the second in the epic trilogy of first person shooter games that re-defined the genre. Experience the pulse-pounding action as you once again defend humanity from the alien Pfhor.
=====
"Move fast, seize the initiative, wield superior firepower, dive into the melee, anticipate enemy movements, slaughter the defenseless, endure."
=====
FEATURES
- 28 levels divided into nine chapters
- missions include exploration, puzzles and extermination
- smooth game play experience
- "Carnage is as easy as point and shoot."
- 8 unique weapons including:
 .45 Magnum Mega Class Pistol
 WSTE-M5 Combat Shotgun
 M.75 Assault Rifle/Grenade Launcher
 Zeus Class Fusion Pistol
 TOZT-7 flamethrower
 ... and the devastating SPNKR-X17 rocket launcher
** NOTE: Invert aim is available through the Settings app, under "Durandal"
=====
"Being naked in space stinks. Lucky for you, Mr. Security officer, you are dressed in active military uniform, complete with a Cyberhead helmet. Your Cyberhead device is your interface to your surrounding environment."
=====
STORY
- battle against the aggressive Pfhor
- play the role of the cyborg security officer
- uncover the surprising secrets of the Pfhor and their allies
=====
"Carnage is as easy as point and shoot. Different weapons are characterized with different dynamics. It is unwise, for example, to use the rocket launcher in close combat."
=====
BUNGIE™, MARATHON® and the Bungie and Marathon logos are either trademarks or registered trademarks of Bungie, Inc., used with permission.

apple-macos:6819546389.name: Jikfu: Quick Reply Keyboard
apple-macos:6819546389.description:
How many times a day do you type the same thing? Jikfu saves the phrases you use most as cards, grouped by scenario — quotes, scheduling, follow-ups — each in its own group.
Switch to the Jikfu keyboard in any text field that allows third-party keyboards and tap a card: the text goes straight into the field, in messages, email, notes or forms. No copy and paste.
The same cards on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Build a set on your Mac and it is there on your iPhone when you go out.
SCENARIOS
• A scenario is one group of cards you use together (quotes, scheduling, after-sales follow-up)
• Switch scenario and the panel changes to that group, so you are not scrolling through dozens of lines
• A card can belong to more than one scenario; tags and a Recently used list make it one step
IN ANY APP
• Works in any text field that allows third-party keyboards, not just a few apps
• No copying back and forth between two apps — pick a card and the text is already there
• On Mac, a global shortcut opens the card panel and pastes back into the app you were just using; the first 27 cards have built-in shortcuts
ONE SET OF CARDS, THREE DEVICES
• iPhone, iPad and Mac sync through the private database of your own Apple Account
• Cards you build on the Mac are ready on your iPhone when you leave
• One subscription covers all three
KEYBOARD
• One card can hold several language versions, such as Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and English; switch with the language button
• Compose: pick a few sentences step by step and insert them as one reply
• You check the text and press send yourself — Jikfu never sends messages for you
CREATE CARDS
• Text, link, image and colour cards
• Take a photo or choose one from Photos and read the text in it on your device
• Use Apple Translation to draft other language versions
• Use Share in other apps to add text, links or images to Jikfu
• Pin and reorder cards; deleted items go to the Trash and can be restored within 7 days
SYNC AND BACKUP
• iCloud sync is on by default on iPhone and iPad (you can turn it off) and can be turned on in Mac settings
• One ZIP backup file exports or restores scenarios, cards and images
• Optional automatic backup to iCloud Drive, keeping the latest 7
• Export a single scenario or card as a file; text and link cards can be exported as CSV
PRIVACY
• No sign-up, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics or tracking
• Optionally require Face ID or the device passcode when opening the app
• The Jikfu keyboard does not read the conversations in other apps or what you are typing; some features (such as the clipboard and copying images) need you to allow Full Access for the keyboard in Settings
APPEARANCE
Moon White, Ink Night, and limited styles: Guochao Gold, Salmon Guochao Gold and Eagle Guochao Gold (limited styles may change or be removed in future versions).
SUBSCRIPTION
The free version lets you create up to 10 cards and use every other feature. Subscribe to remove the limit — choose monthly, six-month or annual billing; the features are the same. Prices for each plan are shown in the App Store. Eligible new subscribers get a free trial (length shown by the App Store). When a subscription ends, the free 10-card limit returns and your existing cards are kept. One subscription works on iPhone, iPad and Mac. In Settings › Subscription & Plans you can enter an offer code, restore purchases or manage your subscription.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.henrychan0508.com/Jikfu/privacy-en.html
MAC
The same purchase includes the Mac app (from the Mac App Store): call up the card panel with a keyboard shortcut and click a card to copy or paste it.
